Who it’s for

This class is for you if you’re done with the same story

  • The names change, but the way things go wrong feels familiar.
  • You’ve read the advice and watched the videos, and still end up in the same place.
  • You want to understand why you’re drawn to who you’re drawn to.
  • You’re ready to build standards you actually keep, from the first date.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 90 minutes

Why dating patterns repeat

It’s rarely bad luck. How what feels familiar quietly decides who gets your attention.

The chemistry trap

Why an instant “spark” can be a sign of familiarity rather than a good match, and what to look for instead.

Rebuild yourself first

Standards, boundaries and self-respect: the foundations that change who you say yes to.

How to choose better

The early signals worth paying attention to, and how to pace things so you see someone clearly.

Where you get stuck, and why it’s the same point every time

A simple way to spot the exact moment your pattern takes over, so you can recognise it next time.
